  - text: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name. Please
  - link "search for Accessibility tree in Wikipedia" [e34]:
    - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=Accessibility+tree&title=Special%3ASearch&fulltext=1
  - text: to check for alternative titles or spellings.
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - text: You need to
      - link "log in or create an account" [e35]:
        - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special%3AUserLogin&returnto=Accessibility+tree&experiments%5B0%5D=we-1-8-account-creation-no-desktop-benefits%3Aunsampled
      - text: and be
      - link "autoconfirmed" [e36]:
        - /url: /wiki/Wikipedia:User_access_levels#Autoconfirmed_users
      - text: to create new articles. Alternatively, you can use the
      - link "article wizard" [e37]:
        - /url: /wiki/Wikipedia:Article_wizard
      - text: to submit a draft for review, or
      - link "request a new article" [e38]:
        - /url: /wiki/Wikipedia:Requested_articles
      - text: .

      - text: Titles on Wikipedia are
      - link "case sensitive" [e41]:
        - /url: /wiki/Case_sensitivity
      - text: except for the first character; please
      - link "check alternative capitalizations" [e42]:
        - /url: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=Accessibility+tree&title=Special%3ASearch&fulltext=1
      - text: and consider adding a
      - link "redirect" [e43]:
        - /url: /wiki/Wikipedia:Redirect
      - text: here to the correct title.
